profile_text.body:
Broadcom Inc. is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and trades under the ticker AVGO. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001730168. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering semiconductors and infrastructure software for global enterprises' most complex, mission-critical needs, and it uses the tagline "Connecting Everything."

The material available does not list any AI products or MCP servers associated with the company. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, with 281 matters.
